exposure: trial of labor after previous caesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: Sixty-one pregnant women with a history of one previous lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) who were suitable for a trial of labor after previous caesarean (TOLAC) were enrolled.
finding: The trial of VBAC in selected cases demonstrated a considerable success rate of 62.3% and was not associated with serious maternal and foetal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: 62.3% of patients achieved successful VBAC, while 37.7% underwent repeat emergency LSCS, with cervical dilatation >4 cm and previous VBAC identified as significant factors for successful VBAC.
